Mod.Name: Chocobo Hot & Cold Radar
Mod.Author: JustPeace
Mod.Description:
Shows the current dig point of the Chocobo Hot & Cold mini-game in real time.
- A pulsing beacon and ground ring mark the exact treasure spot in Chocobo's Forest, the Lagoon and the Air Garden - A HUD compass points towards the treasure relative to the camera, with the distance in metres - An edge arrow appears when the treasure is outside the camera view - The mini-game's own "Kweh" proximity level (1-5) is displayed as five dots and drives the marker colour - Optional overlay of all nine candidate dig points for debugging
All values are read from the game's own event variables; no save data or game files are modified.
Configuration is in ChocoboHotCold/ChocoboHotCold.ini.
Mod.PatchNotes: Version 1.0.1: remove the redundant battle-init fallback so the radar no longer competes with FloatingHPBar for the exclusive hook. Independent startup and treasure rendering are retained. Version 1.0: first release.
